title: Reader TOC long book titles wrap and crowd the directory header
symptom: A long book title in the reader directory header could wrap to multiple lines and consume extra vertical space above the chapter list. A Pixel 8 / Android 14 Compose regression reproduced this at 320dp width: the long book title measured 48dp high while a short single-line title measured 24dp.
root_cause: ReaderTocSheet constrained long chapter row titles after BUG-2026-041, but the directory header book title still rendered unconstrained title text. Long imported book names or names that include subtitle/author information could therefore expand the header and crowd the list content.
fix: Constrained the ReaderTocSheet header book title to one line.
Rendered overflowing TOC book titles with TextOverflow.Ellipsis.
Added a Compose instrumented regression that compares a long book title against a short single-line book title at 320dp width.
failed_attempts: Fixing only TOC chapter row titles does not cover the separate header book title text path.
Long-title parser corpus tests do not prove directory header layout remains stable; the Compose header itself needs a visual height assertion.
impact: Keeps the directory header compact for long imported book names and preserves usable vertical space for chapter choices.
